answer_1.quote: Data-to-text (D2T) generation is the process of converting structured data, like meaning representations or knowledge graphs, into coherent and fluent natural language text.
answer_1.outputs: Generated natural language texts describing the input RDF triples

answer_2.quote: Table 1 reports the automatic evaluation scores for three systems... Across most metrics recorded, including BLEU, METEOR, ChrF++, TER, BERT_F1, BLEURT, and COMET, the E2E system consistently achieves the highest scores.

answer_3.quote: In addition to human annotation, we also applied an LLM-as-judge approach, using GPT o3 (OpenAI, 2025b), Claude Sonnet 3.7 by Anthropic (Anthropic, 2024), and Gemini 2.5 Pro to assess outputs according to the same criteria.

answer_4.quote: Three co-authors served as annotators for the human evaluation. The assessment was conducted in a blind fashion... Outputs were evaluated on a 7-point Likert scale (1 -lowest, 7 -highest) using four criteria: fluency, grammaticality, no-omission, and no-addition.
answer_4.guideline: Blind human annotators rated each output on a 7-point Likert scale for fluency, grammaticality, no-omission, and no-addition.
